request.spec:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The audit viewer, filtered by a name, now also lists the matching lines of the sheet's descendants
(each sheet's lines newest first, sheets by id, after this sheet's own lines and before the lines
from the sheet a person came from).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

agent.result_text:
When you filter the audit viewer by a name, it now also shows that person's lines from every sheet below the current one: its child sheets, their children, and so on. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The lines come in this order:
1. This sheet's own lines, newest first.
2. Each descendant sheet's lines, newest first, with the sheets taken in order of their id.
3. The lines from the sheet the person came from, as before.

The change is only in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/audit/AuditViewService.java`. It finds the descendants by looking up each sheet's children through the existing sheet repository, and it skips any sheet it has already seen or that loops back to the starting sheet.

Two behaviours to be aware of:
- **No filter, no change:** with an empty filter the viewer still lists only this sheet's lines, which is what the test expects.
- **Possible repeated lines:** if the sheet a person came from is also one of the descendants, its lines will appear twice. I left that alone because the request didn't say how to handle it and no test covers it.

No front-end or stored-data changes were needed.
